name: sabeel
description: Sabeel — Quran, Hadith, Prayer, Dua. Free forever, no ads, no tracking, offline-first.

scripts.data:all: npm run data:quran && npm run data:layout && npm run data:dua && npm run data:reciters && npm run data:adhan && npm run data:geomag && npm run data:hadith && npm run data:adhkar && npm run data:index && npm run data:fonts && npm run data:icons2 && npm run data:illus && npm run data:icons && npm run data:verify
scripts.test: node scripts/check-imports.mjs && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/test-swipe.mjs && node scripts/audit-sources.mjs && node scripts/check-release.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android-setup.mjs
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
